title: 14:29 Rejoice not thou, whole Palestina, because the rod of him that smote thee is broken. Palestine, or Philistia, which consists of five kingdoms—Gaza, Ekron, Gath, Ashdod, and Ashkalon—is warned not to celebrate Assyria's (the "serpent's") lost power, because the Assyrians will regain their strength (the serpent's seed will produce a cockatrice, another poisonous serpent) and once again smite the Philistines.
author: Tina M. Peterson
